Cassian: Hey all — Cassian here, first day! Remote-first but I'll be in-office Tue/Thu. Quick q: I have a pet ferret (very chill) — any office pet policy I should know about? Also looking for recs on a compact power strip and whether there's a small locker for my turntables. :wave:
Mira: Welcome Cassian!! :tada: Re ferret — check w/ people ops but short visits are usually fine if we book a private room. For a full-time office pet we'd need an accommodation form.
Tara (People Ops): Hi @Cassian, welcome 👋 Small pets in shared spaces are a no-go, but private visits are OK with prior notice. DM me and we'll sort a visitor slot. Badge is ready at reception.
office-bot: Desk 42T reserved for Cassian on Tue/Thu. Map: https://redwood-office.example/maps/level4#42T
office-bot: To book a focus room use:
```
/room book focus-3 2024-06-04 10:00-12:00
```
Juno: If you bring turntables drop them in the gear locker (near bike room) — it's small but secure. We keep an aux cable in the lounge speakers. :headphones:
Ethan: Welcome!! Power-strip recs: avoid daisy-chaining, get a unit with built-in surge and a switch. This one is small and solid: https://tiny.example/powerstrip (company isn't endorsing purchases, just a personal rec).
Mira: Also FYI — standing-desk height presets are saved per badge on desks 40-45. Ping infra if the motor's noisy.
Cassian: Awesome, thanks everyone — I'll DM Tara and swing by reception later. Excited to be here! :raised_hands:
